_why: Ratchet floors, ported from sheleg-design after its retro recorded the class: a gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit. Every script listed here reads its own floor -- two of these three were recorded and never read until SU-01.
